🟠 **High** `Adapters/ClaudeAdapterV2.ts:769` Native Claude forks in npm installations fail because Node is started with a nonexistent `claude-history-worker.mjs` path. The worker is emitted at `dist/claude-history-worker.mjs`, while this relative URL resolves beside the adapter; resolve the worker from the adapter directory to the emitted `dist` root.
🤖 Copy this AI Prompt to have your agent fix this: ```text In file @apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/Adapters/ClaudeAdapterV2.ts around line 769: Native Claude forks in npm installations fail because Node is started with a nonexistent `claude-history-worker.mjs` path. The worker is emitted at `dist/claude-history-worker.mjs`, while this relative URL resolves beside the adapter; resolve the worker from the adapter directory to the emitted `dist` root. ```

_🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Set a deadline for the history worker.**

If the worker stalls during an SDK history operation, `child.exitCode` and the stream drains can wait indefinitely. The 1 MiB limits cap retained output, not execution time. Apply a timeout to the scoped fork operation so a stalled worker releases the fork request and its child process. ([effect.website](https://effect.website/docs/v4/api/effect/process/ChildProcessSpawner?utm_source=openai))
